note: The exact bytes an operator's signature is over. Written by hand in three places -- the desktop builds it with .join("\n"), the desktop's Rust side rebuilds it in a format! string, and the sidecar's consent module builds it a third time -- so all three assert against THIS file rather than against each other's memory of it. preimage_hex is the 0x-hex of the UTF-8 bytes, recorded as hex so trailing whitespace and newline handling cannot be guessed. THE EIP-191 PREFIX IS APPLIED OVER THE DECODED BYTES, NEVER OVER THE HEX STRING: get it wrong and every operator signature fails, get it inconsistently wrong and the desktop accepts a record the sidecar refuses.
